Liquid metal button

Motionby @BrettFromDJ2026-08-24inspora pageoriginal post

What it is

Liquid metal button: a capsule button labeled 'Elements' whose rim is a living chrome edge - a bright specular highlight with rainbow dispersion streaks travels continuously around the pill's border like liquid metal; it sits in a machined grey track with a 'PORTFOLIO' slot below.

Build prompt

Build a liquid-metal capsule button. Button: 200x64px full-round pill, face = vertical gradient #F7F7F8 -> #E9E9EC with a 1px inner top highlight and a soft drop shadow. The rim is the trick: wrap the pill in a 2px ring painted with a conic gradient - mostly neutral grey, but with a bright white specular segment (~40deg arc) flanked by thin rainbow dispersion bands (red/cyan fringes, 60% opacity); rotate the conic angle 360deg over 4s linear infinite so the highlight orbits the rim like flowing chrome. Add a matching inner shadow whose offset drifts with the highlight angle (fake lighting consistency). Hover: highlight speed doubles and the face gradient lifts 4% brighter (200ms). Set it in a machined track: a grey (#D8D8DA) rounded channel with a debossed 'PORTFOLIO' caption beneath, letterspaced 2px, 50% opacity.
